title: Praktikum (m/w/d) Finance & Accounting
description: Wir bei Repower Solution glauben daran, dass die Zukunft der Energie grün, smart und nachhaltig ist. Willst Du weg von der Theorie und praktisch mit anpacken? Dann unterstütze uns als Praktikant (m/w/d) dabei, unsere Finanzen im Hintergrund stabil aufzustellen und die Energiewende auch zahlenmäßig auf Erfolgskurs zu halten. Als junges, dynamisches Unternehmen entwickeln wir innovative Lösungen für die Energiewende – praxisnah, technologiegetrieben und mit echtem Impact. Unser Team besteht aus leidenschaftlichen Profis, die nicht nur in Photovoltaik, Elektromobilität und Wärmepumpentechnologie zuhause sind, sondern auch Finanzierungsmöglichkeiten clever mitdenken. Gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden setzen wir zukunftsweisende Projekte um – von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung. Aufgaben Vorbereitende Buchhaltung: Du unterstützt unser Finance-Team im operativen Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass alle Prozesse reibungslos laufen. Belegmanagement: Du übernimmst die digitale Belegablage sowie die lückenlose Belegnachverfolgung. Zahlungsabgleich & OPOS: Du hast die offenen Posten (OPOS-Listen) fest im Blick und übernimmst den eigenständigen Zahlungsabgleich. Rechnungsprüfung: Du prüfst eingehende Rechnungen auf Herz und Nieren und führst einfache Kontenabstimmungen durch. Finance-Support: Du unterstützt uns tatkräftig bei betriebswirtschaftlichen Auswertungen und übernimmst administrative Aufgaben im Finanzbereich. Qualifikation Dein Fundament: Du bist eingeschriebene*r Student*in, idealerweise im Bereich Wirtschaftswissenschaften, BWL, Finance & Accounting oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang mit Zahlenfokus. Deine Motivation: Erneuerbare Energien und Zukunftsmodelle bringen Dich in Fahrt und geben Dir einen Grund, morgens aufzustehen. Dein Mindset: Du hast eine ausgeprägte Affinität zu Zahlen, arbeitest extrem präzise, strukturiert und absolut zuverlässig. Deine Tools: MS Office (insbesondere Excel) ist für Dich kein Fremdwort, und Du hast Lust, Dich schnell in moderne Buchhaltungstools einzuarbeiten. Datev Kenntnisse sind von Vorteil, aber kein Muss. Sprache: Du sprichst verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (C2) und kannst Dich auch auf Englisch (B2) gut ausdrücken. Benefits Flache Hierarchien & offene Unternehmenskultur: Deine Meinung zählt – wir schätzen Deine Expertise und Ideen. Top Lage in Köln: Unser Büro liegt zentral, ist hervorragend erreichbar und umgeben von kulinarischer Vielfalt. Ein starkes Team: Von Tag eins an wirst Du Dich willkommen fühlen – wir leben ein familiäres und wertschätzendes Miteinander. Weiterentwicklung & Perspektive: Wir fördern Deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung und bieten Dir langfristige Wachstumsmöglichkeiten (z. B. für Deine Abschlussarbeit oder einen späteren Festeinstieg). Flexibles Arbeiten: Ob im Büro oder mal von zu Hause – wir bieten Dir Flexibilität, wo es möglich ist, damit sich Job und Studium perfekt vereinbaren lassen. Moderne Ausstattung: Ein ergonomischer Arbeitsplatz und moderne Tools unterstützen Dich bei Deiner täglichen Arbeit. Regelmäßige Team-Events: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge und sorgen für eine gute Zeit gemeinsam. Urban Sports Mitglieschaft für den Ausgleich nach Feierabend. Klingt nach Dir? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung – und darauf, Dich bald persönlich kennenzulernen! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Senior UX/UI Designer (m/w/d)
raw.description:

📍 Standort: Berlin · gut erreichbar mit Bus & Bahn

🗣 Sprache: Deutsch > C1 · Englisch ab B2

Aufgaben

🚀 Du berätst, moderierst und gestaltest.

Du lieferst bei uns nicht nur Screens ab. Du berätst Kund:innen, moderierst Workshops und machst aus komplexen Anwendungen eine klare Nutzererfahrung.

Wir sind ein Design-Team, bestehend vier Designer:innen. Wir arbeiten kooperativ, direkt und mit klarer Feedbackkultur. Im Handwerk sind wir stark: Figma, Design Systeme, Sorgfalt bis ins Detail.

Warum es diese Stelle gibt: Wir wachsen, und unsere Projekte werden größer und anspruchsvoller. Deshalb verstärken wir das Team. 🧭 Deine Aufgaben – so könntest du starten

  • Kennenlernen unserer Projekte und Kund:innen sowie der Design Systeme, mit denen sie arbeiten
  • Einarbeitung in bestehende Konzepte und laufende Projekte
  • Übernahme erster Konzept- und UI-Aufgaben: Wireframes, Prototypen, Screens
  • Begleitung von Kundenterminen und Workshops im Team

🎯 Wenn du eingearbeitet bist, übernimmst du Verantwortung für

  • eigene Projekte als Hauptverantwortliche:r, vom Aufnehmen der Anforderungen über die Konzeption bis zur Übergabe an die Entwicklung und der Begleitung während der Umsetzung
  • Beratung deiner Kund:innen sowie Präsentation und Verteidigung deiner Konzepte
  • Planung und Moderation von Workshops mit Kund:innen und Team
  • UX Research: User Interviews und Tests planen, durchführen und auswerten
  • komplexe UX-Aufgaben in großen Anwendungen sowie die Pflege und Weiterentwicklung von Design Systemen (Design Ops)
  • Aufwandsschätzungen für Angebote und enge Abstimmung mit PM und Entwicklung

Qualifikation

🧩 Was du mitbringst

Must-have

  • Erfahrung als UX/UI Designer:in im Agenturumfeld, in interdisziplinären Teams mit PM und Entwicklung
  • Sicherheit in Beratung, Kundenkommunikation und in der Moderation von Workshops (Facilitation)
  • Erfahrung mit komplexer UX-Arbeit in großen Anwendungen und mit dem Aufbau, der Pflege und Weiterentwicklung von Design Systemen (Design Ops)
  • Sehr gute Figma-Kenntnisse
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (> C1)

Nice-to-have

  • Wissen zu iOS- und Android-Guidelines
  • Agile Arbeitsweise (Scrum, Kanban o. Ä.)

✨ Was dich erwartet

  • Kleines Team, große Projekte – dein Impact ist sichtbar
  • Verantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum statt Umsetzer-Rolle
  • Kooperative Führung, Vertrauen und eine direkte Feedbackkultur
  • Wöchentliches Team-Frühstück, regelmäßige After-Work-Events und ein jährliches TBO-Offsite
  • Deutschland-Ticket
  • Bonusmodell zusätzlich zum Fixgehalt

Benefits

Bei TBO leben wir eine offene Unternehmenskultur und entspannte, aber konzentrierte Arbeitsatmosphäre. Du hast hohe  Gestaltungsspielräume  und arbeitest an spannenden Projekten in einem  modernen Arbeitsumfeld aus eigenverantwortlichen Teams erfahrener App- und Web-Entwickler sowie UI- und UX-Designer. Du bekommst auf Dich zugeschnittene Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten, die dafür sorgen, dass Du dich persönlich weiterentwickeln kannst. Team: Product & Engineering

Start date: As soon as possible

Location: Berlin — hybrid, 3 days in the office

Working language: English (German: a plus)

Salary band: Shared before your first interview

Your impact

As Growth Product Manager at 7NXT Health Group, you drive subscriber growth across all our brands. You find the problems behind our key metrics, test your way to solutions, and make sure what we learn in one brand helps the others. Your focus spans the subscriber lifecycle — with the emphasis on its two ends: acquisition and retention.

You work in close collaboration with Marketing to bring the right people in and find the right offers to keep them: a lot of testing on pricing, offers, landing pages and cancellation flows. This is a mid-level role with real ownership in a fast-moving environment.

What you’ll drive

  • You own the experimentation roadmap, from metric to hypothesis to shipped test and clear result

  • You partner closely with Marketing and CRM on funnels, landing pages and campaigns, and own the testing of pricing and offers

  • You share what works across the group, so a win in one brand becomes a test in another

What defines you

Must-have

  • Experimentation and growth mindset. You turn a metric into customer problems and sharp hypotheses, run sound A/B tests, and build a roadmap around what will move the number.

  • Data and customer insight. You do your own analysis, from funnels to test read-outs, and combine it with research and interviews to find the real problem.

  • Hands-on attitude, comfortable using AI. You build and launch things yourself — landing pages, tests and prototypes — and use AI to automate your workflows.

  • Ownership. You own outcomes end to end and step in beyond your scope when the team needs it.

  • Communication and structure. You align Marketing, design, engineering and leadership around evidence, and document learnings so the whole group can use them.

  • 3–5 years in product, growth or a related role in a digital B2C product, with a track record of running A/B tests

Nice-to-have

  • Experience in a subscription business: trials, paywalls, pricing, churn and LTV dynamics

We believe in trust over rigid structures, smart working over endless meetings — and that sustainability, inclusion and diversity aren’t buzzwords, they’re how we actually operate.

description: Wir bei HAAS bieten seit mehr als 25 Jahren hochwertige Fort- und Weiterbildungen im Steuerrecht für Steuerberater:innen und Mitarbeiter:innen in steuerberatenden Unternehmen. Puh, Steuerrecht?! Keine Angst, weiterlesen lohnt sich: Pro Jahr veranstalten wir ca. 600 Präsenzseminare in ganz Deutschland und produzieren in unserem hauseigenen Studio etwa 100 Webinare sowie weitere Video-Formate für Social Media. Unsere Zielgruppe vertraut und schätzt uns als zentrale Anlaufstelle, um zu allen Änderungen im Steuerrecht auf dem neuesten Stand zu bleiben. Im Herzen der Südstadt von Hannover planen und organisieren wir diese Veranstaltungen und alles, was dazugehört. Als Digital Experience Manager:in bei HAAS verantwortest du die digitale Kundenerfahrung – von unserer Website über Inhalte und Conversion-Strecken bis zu den dahinterliegenden Prozessen und Systemen. Du bist zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Marketing, Technologie und unseren Kunden und entwickelst unser digitales Angebot kontinuierlich weiter. DEINE ROLLE BEI UNS Konkret verantwortest du zu gleichen Teilen drei Aufgabenbereiche: 1. Du machst unsere Website jeden Tag ein Stück besser. Du verantwortest bzw. steuerst die Erstellung, Pflege und Weiterentwicklung sämtlicher Inhalte unserer Website. Dazu gehören unter anderem: Fachbeiträge Seminar- und Webinarbeschreibungen Checkout-Prozess Landingpages Produktankündigungen Webinar-Ausschnitte und weitere digitale Formate Du bereitest komplexe steuerliche Inhalte verständlich, zielgruppengerecht und nutzerfreundlich auf. Dabei denkst du stets aus Sicht unserer Kunden und hinterfragst bestehende Inhalte kontinuierlich: Versteht man das? Ist das relevant? Ist das die bestmögliche Lösung? Wird der Nutzer optimal geführt? Aktualität, Qualität und Konsistenz unserer Inhalte sind dabei dein persönlicher Anspruch. Nach deiner Einarbeitung verstehst du nicht nur, was auf unserer Website passiert, sondern auch, was dahinterliegt. Du kennst die relevanten Systeme und Datenflüsse, kannst Fehler eingrenzen und erkennst selbstständig Verbesserungspotenziale. 2. Du analysierst, statt zu reporten Du arbeitest datengetrieben und maximal kundenzentriert. Hierzu analysierst du regelmäßig: Website-KPIs Teilnehmerzahlen Nutzerverhalten Suchanfragen Wettbewerber Conversion-Strecken Du baust die Auswertungen und Dashboards, die du dafür brauchst, erkennst Zusammenhänge und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab. Für dich beginnt Analyse mit der Auswertungund endet mit konkreten Verbesserungsmaßnahmen. Du erkennst Optimierungspotenziale frühzeitig, entwickelst eigene Ideen und setzt diese konsequent um. In enger Abstimmung mit dem restlichen Team identifizierst du kleine und große Verbesserungspotenziale am Produkt und der Website und setzt diese kontinuierlich. 3. Du möchtest neben deinem Studium echte Einblicke in die Welt von Cloud Partnerschaften gewinnen, Verantwortung übernehmen und dabei lernen, wie ein internationales Cloud Consulting Unternehmen mit AWS auf Augenhöhe zusammenarbeitet. Bei Skaylink arbeitest du nicht nur mit, sondern wächst fachlich, persönlich und technologisch in einem Umfeld, das Entwicklung ernst meint.

Was du bei uns machst
  • Du arbeitest dich in die Welt der AWS Partnerprogramme ein und übernimmst Verantwortung für Partnerdaten sowie Zertifizierungen.
  • Du arbeitest aktiv an AWS Partnerprogrammen mit und unterstützt bei Funding Anträgen.
  • Du erstellst Präsentationen, Analysen und regelmäßige Partnerstatus Reports.
  • Du dokumentierst interne Prozesse, denkst diese weiter und hältst sie strukturiert in Confluence aktuell.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing und Sales zusammen und unterstützt bei Events sowie Marketing Aktivitäten.
  • Du übernimmst projektbezogene Aufgaben im Rahmen von Partnerinitiativen und baust dabei tiefes AWS Partner Know-How auf.

    • Wann du zu uns passt
  • Du bist immatrikuliert in einem Studiengang im Bereich Wirtschaftsinformatik, Digital Business, BWL mit IT-Schwerpunkt, Informatik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang
  • Du hast echtes Interesse an Public Cloud, AWS Technologien und Partnerökosystemen.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenständig und hast Lust, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.
  • Erste Berührungspunkte mit AWS oder Cloud Services sind ein Plus, Lernbereitschaft ist entscheidend.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch und Englischkenntnisse und nutzt beide selbstverständlich im Arbeitsalltag.
    • Hey, wir sind Skaylink.
    Begleite uns auf unserer Cloud Journey!
     

    Als Part of Vodafone bringen wir unsere Cloud-DNA und Innovationskraft ein. Gemeinsam treiben wir zentrale Cloud- und Transformationsprojekte voran. Von Cloud-Migrationen über Security-Lösungen bis hin zu Modern-Work-Projekten schaffen wir spürbaren Mehrwert für unsere Kund*innen. Dabei nutzen wir Synergien und bündeln unsere Stärken. So entstehen Lösungen mit nachhaltiger Wirkung und genau das macht uns zu einem der führenden Anbieter im Bereich Cloud-Technologien. 

    Unser Anspruch ist es, echte Ergebnisse zu schaffen, die messbar Wirkung zeigen und Projekte nachhaltig voranbringen. Wir beraten nicht nur, sondern setzen um. Denn Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Wirkung zu erzielen, gehört für uns zusammen. 

    Bei uns zählen deine Expertise, deine Leidenschaft und deine Motivation, etwas zu bewegen. Unterschiedliche Hintergründe, Perspektiven und Erfahrungen machen uns stark. Sie schaffen den Raum, in dem du dich einbringen und weiterentwickeln kannst. 

    Wenn du nicht nur mitlaufen, sondern wirklich etwas bewegen willst, bist du bei uns richtig. 

     
    Was du von uns hast
     
    🎯 Purpose – Deine Expertise einsetzen 
    📖 Entwicklung – Ankommen und Weiterkommen (u. a. Skaylink Campus, Entwicklungsgespräche, regelmäßige Befragungen der Mitarbeitenden)
    🏖️ Erholung – Kraft tanken (u. a. 30 Tage Urlaub, 24. + 31.12 frei) 
    💻 Ausstattung – Die Qual der Wahl (Apple/Windows)

title: Working Student / Internship  HR Business Partner (m/f/d)
description: About the role: As a Working Student in our HR Business Partnering Team, you will be a key part of our People Team to support and guide our Early Professionals (our working students, interns, and thesis students) throughout their entire journey at Quantum-Systems. Together with our World-Class Team, currently 4 team members, you will take an empowering role: pushing the boundaries of drone technologies. Your focus is to ensure our Early Professionals have a well-supported experience throughout their time at Quantum-Systems, while supporting our Business Partnering team to drive strategic people topics. Enabling a strong Early Professionals community is essential to Quantum-Systems, and your mission will be a powerful impact. Whether you are looking for a mandatory internship, a working student position, or a combination of both, we would love to hear from you. Ideally, you will continue supporting our team beyond the internship period, giving you the opportunity to contribute to strategic initiatives such as our performance development, compensation, Business Partnering projects, and the growth of our People team, while building valuable hands-on HR experience. What is your Day to Day Mission: Be the primary point of contact for our Early Professionals, supporting them within their employee lifecycle Actively manage and coordinate onboarding, feedback conversations, development and offboarding Coordinate closely with Recruiting, HR Operations, and managers, acting as a trusted sparring partner between management and our Early Professionals Contribute to projects within our HR Business Partnering team, such as creating guidelines and setting up new initiatives and workshops Support managers in identifying support from Early Professionals, development needs and creating tailored learning and career paths for our Early Professionals What you bring to the team: You are currently studying Human Resource Management, Business Psychology, Business Administration, Economics, International Business, or a comparable field. You already have practical experience in HR (would be a benefit). You are privately interested in volunteering in community or social projects or being part of f.e. sport teams. Due to your open and communicative attitude, you quickly earn trust from our Early Professionals. You are highly self-motivated. You keep a good overview even when juggling different topics at once. Good German and English skills are a must. Why Quantum-Systems: We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus. We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary. We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data. We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth. Our benefits: Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance. Mobile working: If it gets too turbulent for you in our office, you can get the necessary balance through mobile working. Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership. Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia. Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together. Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored. Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday. About us: Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. Du möchtest die Gesellschaft von morgen mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei ]init[ richtig. Denn unsere digitalen Lösungen sind für Menschen gemacht und haben gesellschaftliche Relevanz. Klingt spannend? Dann steig ein und arbeite gemeinsam mit über 1.400 ]init[s in interdisziplinären Teams an unseren sieben Standorten – oder flexibel von überall in Deutschland aus.


Deine Mission bei ]init[

Du willst Digitalisierung dort vorantreiben, wo sie gesellschaftlich wirklich zählt? Als Senior Project Manager (all genders) gestaltest und steuerst du anspruchsvolle digitale Verwaltungsprojekte rund um Migration & Inneres. Du bringst Kund:innen, Fachlichkeit und Technologie zusammen und machst aus komplexen Anforderungen digitale Lösungen, die in der Praxis funktionieren.


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Du realisierst anspruchsvolle IT- und Digitalisierungsprojekte von gesellschaftlicher Relevanz mit besonderem Fokus auf die Fachthemen Migration & Inneres – agil oder hybrid.
  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Projekte über die gesamte Projektlaufzeit und steuerst Scope, Time, Budget, Qualität und Risiken.
  • Du arbeitest mit interdisziplinäre Projektteams, in unterschiedlichen technologischen Kontexten – von digitalen Verwaltungsleistungen und Fachanwendungen über Content- und Formular-Management-Systeme bis hin zu individuellen IT-Lösungen zusammen und sorgst für eine strukturierte und verlässliche Zusammenarbeit innerhalb des Projekts.
  • Als zentrale Schnittstelle koordinierst du interne und externe Stakeholder und arbeitest eng mit unseren Kund:innen aus der öffentlichen Verwaltung zusammen. Gemeinsam mit interdisziplinären Teams übersetzt du die Anforderungen unserer Kund:innen in tragfähige IT-Lösungen und digitale Prozesse und begleitest deren Umsetzung von der Konzeption bis zum erfolgreichen Go-live.
  • Du begleitest unsere Kund:innen bei Fragestellungen rund um die digitale Transformation und erkennst dabei auch Potenziale für die Weiterentwicklung bestehender Projekte und Lösungen.


Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projektmanagement von  Entwicklungs- oder Digitalisierungsprojekten und kannst Projekte eigenständig und Ende-zu-Ende steuern.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Steuerung interdisziplinärer Projektteams und übernimmst sicher Verantwortung für Scope, Budget, Time,  Qualität und Risiken.
  • Idealerweise bringst du bereits Erfahrung mit Digitalisierungsprojekten der öffentlichen Verwaltung und/oder einen fachlichen Bezug zu den Themen Migration & Inneres mit.
  • Du kennst und schätzt die Zusammenarbeit mit externen Kund:innen und verstehst Projektmanagement als kundenorientierte Delivery-Rolle und bewegst dich mit deinem Kommunikationsgeschick souverän auf unterschiedlichen Ebenen der Projektorganisation.
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit agilen und/oder klassischen Projektmethoden. Erfahrung mit skalierten agilen Vorgehensweisen oder hybriden Projekt-Set-ups ist ein Plus.
  • Idealerweise verfügst du über eine relevante Projektmanagement- oder Agile-Zertifizierung, z. B. PRINCE2, PMI, Scrum PSM/PSPO
  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium bildet die fachliche Grundlage für deine Tätigkeit bei uns.
  • Du bringst sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mit.


Das bieten wir dir

  • Because we care: 30 Urlaubstage und Workation innerhalb der EU schaffen Freiraum für Erholung und neue Perspektiven. So lassen sich Beruf und Privatleben gut miteinander verbinden.
  • Work with us: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten und Teilzeitmodelle ermöglichen dir, Arbeit und Alltag passend zu gestalten – immer abgestimmt mit deinem Team und deinen Projekten.
  • Learn with us: Mit der ]init[ Academy, Trainings, Zertifizierungen und bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch entwickelst du dich fachlich und persönlich kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Grow with us: Profitiere von bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch und entwickle dich gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleg:innen kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Ride with us: JobRad, ÖPNV-Zuschuss und weitere Mobility Benefits unterstützen dich dabei, flexibel und nachhaltig unterwegs zu sein.
  • Start with us: Welcome Week, strukturiertes Onboarding und Patenschaften sorgen für einen gelungenen Einstieg und helfen dir, schnell im Team und deinen Projekten anzukommen.


Werde Teil des Teams

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft – in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, remote oder im Office.
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.
Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit sind für uns selbstverständlich. Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung und Gleichstellung begrüßen wir ausdrücklich.
 
Da uns und unseren Kund:innen Sicherheit wichtig ist, kann je nach Position nach einer Zusage eine vertrauliche Sicherheitsüberprüfung erforderlich sein.


Recruiter

Anne Kroll

Das gibt es zu tun

  • Du berätst private und öffentliche Kunden aus dem Verteidigungs- und Sicherheitsumfeld bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von hochsicheren Digitalisierungs- und Transformationsvorhaben· Du analysierst komplexe fachliche, organisatorische und technologische Herausforderungen und entwickelst daraus belastbare Lösungsansätze und Zielbilder
  • Du übersetzt militärische Fähigkeiten, operative Anforderungen und strategische Ziele in konkrete digitale Lösungen und technologische Architekturen

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Expert:innen aus Entwicklung, Architektur und Delivery zusammen und übernimmst Verantwortung für die fachliche Qualität der Ergebnisse
  • Du beobachtest technologische und sicherheitspolitische Entwicklungen und leitest daraus relevante Impulse für unsere Kunden und unser Leistungsportfolio ab


Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Beratung, Konzeption oder Steuerung komplexer Digitalisierungs- und IT-Projekte – idealerweise im Verteidigungs-, Sicherheits- oder behördlichen Umfeld
  • Fundiertes Verständnis militärischer Fähigkeitslogiken und kapazitätsorientierter Planung sowie die Fähigkeit, daraus Anforderungen an moderne digitale Lösungen abzuleiten
  • Gutes Verständnis für die Digitalisierung von Führungs- und Einsatzprozessen sowie für Führungsinformationssysteme und deren Integration in bestehende Systemlandschaften

  • Verständnis für Einsatzmöglichkeiten von Drohnen, Sensorik und unbemannten Systemen sowie für das Potenzial von Künstlicher Intelligenz und Datenräumen im militärischen und behördlichen Umfeld

  • Hohe Eigeninitiative, strategisches Denken und die Bereitschaft, Verantwortung für Themen, Kunden und die Weiterentwicklung unseres Beratungsportfolios zu übernehmen
  • Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands und Europa je nach Kundenterminlage
  • Plus: eigener Hintergrund durch geleisteten Dienst in der Bundeswehr oder enge berufliche Berührungspunkte mit der Truppe/Organisation
  • Plus: Berührungspunkte mit Themen wie VS-NfD/Geheimschutz, Sicherheitsüberprüfungen (SÜG) oder vergleichbare Arbeit in regulierten Umfeldern
  • Du bringst sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mit

  • Learn with us: Mit der ]init[ Academy, Trainings, Zertifizierungen und bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch entwickelst du dich fachlich und persönlich kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Grow with us: Profitiere von bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch und entwickle dich gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleg:innen kontinuierlich weiter.

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft - in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, remote oder im Office.

Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit sind für uns selbstverständlich. Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung und Gleichstellung begrüßen wir ausdrücklich.

Das gibt es zu tun

  • Du berätst private und öffentliche Kunden aus dem Verteidigungs- und Sicherheitsumfeld bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von hochsicheren Digitalisierungs- und Transformationsvorhaben· Du analysierst komplexe fachliche, organisatorische und technologische Herausforderungen und entwickelst daraus belastbare Lösungsansätze und Zielbilder
  • Du übersetzt militärische Fähigkeiten, operative Anforderungen und strategische Ziele in konkrete digitale Lösungen und technologische Architekturen

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Expert:innen aus Entwicklung, Architektur und Delivery zusammen und übernimmst Verantwortung für die fachliche Qualität der Ergebnisse
  • Du beobachtest technologische und sicherheitspolitische Entwicklungen und leitest daraus relevante Impulse für unsere Kunden und unser Leistungsportfolio ab


Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Beratung, Konzeption oder Steuerung komplexer Digitalisierungs- und IT-Projekte – idealerweise im Verteidigungs-, Sicherheits- oder behördlichen Umfeld
  • Fundiertes Verständnis militärischer Fähigkeitslogiken und kapazitätsorientierter Planung sowie die Fähigkeit, daraus Anforderungen an moderne digitale Lösungen abzuleiten
  • Gutes Verständnis für die Digitalisierung von Führungs- und Einsatzprozessen sowie für Führungsinformationssysteme und deren Integration in bestehende Systemlandschaften
  • Kenntnisse relevanter Technologien und Lösungsansätze in den Bereichen Cybersecurity, Resilienz, Cloud- und Plattformlösungen sowie sichere Kommunikation und Netze
  • Verständnis für Einsatzmöglichkeiten von Drohnen, Sensorik und unbemannten Systemen sowie für das Potenzial von Künstlicher Intelligenz und Datenräumen im militärischen und behördlichen Umfeld

  • Hohe Eigeninitiative, strategisches Denken und die Bereitschaft, Verantwortung für Themen, Kunden und die Weiterentwicklung unseres Beratungsportfolios zu übernehmen
  • Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands und Europa je nach Kundenterminlage
  • Plus: eigener Hintergrund durch geleisteten Dienst in der Bundeswehr oder enge berufliche Berührungspunkte mit der Truppe/Organisation
  • Plus: Berührungspunkte mit Themen wie VS-NfD/Geheimschutz, Sicherheitsüberprüfungen (SÜG) oder vergleichbare Arbeit in regulierten Umfeldern
  • Du bringst sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mit

  • Grow with us: Profitiere von bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch und entwickle dich gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleg:innen kontinuierlich weiter.

title: Senior Integrated Photonics Packaging Engineer (m/f/d)
description: Your mission The future of AI computing is light, not electrons. As Senior Integrated Photonics Packaging Engineer , you will sit at the very heart of Q.ANT’s photonic hardware R&D. You will research, develop, and demonstrate novel electrical and optical packaging concepts that bring our photonic integrated circuits (PICs) to their full performance potential. Rather than managing external suppliers to deliver off-the-shelf solutions, you will own the hands-on development of packaging architectures end-to-end - from first-principles design through prototyping, benchtop characterization, and validation. By bridging optical, electrical, and thermal domains, you will directly shape the performance, integrability, and scalability of our PIC-based systems. At Q.ANT, we are building photonic processing systems that compute with light - delivering a scalable, energy-efficient alternative to transistor-based architectures for next-generation AI and high-performance computing. Your Impact & Responsibilities Drive Packaging Innovation: Conceive, build, and experimentally validate novel packaging prototypes and assembly methods for the co-integration of PICs with light sources, photodetectors, and high-speed analog electronics. Lead Workstreams End-to-End: Lead packaging R&D workstreams from concept definition and experiment design to hands-on benchtop testing and documented knowledge transfer. Solve First-Principles Engineering Challenges: Define packaging requirements and solve complex optical coupling, RF/microwave signal integrity, and thermal management challenges from a first-principles understanding. Develop Coupling Schemes: Design, build, and measure advanced optical coupling schemes (e.g., edge coupling, grating coupling, lensed fiber, micro-lens arrays). Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with PIC designers, systems engineers, and electronics teams to ensure packaging architectures are co-designed with device- and system-level constraints in mind. Build Institutional Knowledge: Document process recipes, assembly procedures, design rules, and tolerance budgets to enable manufacturability assessments, repeatability, and IP generation. Technical Supplier Alignment: Coordinate with external partners and suppliers for specialized materials or fabrication capabilities as the technical lead who specifies and validates rather than manages delivery. Mentorship & Leadership: Mentor junior engineers and contribute to shaping the team’s overall packaging R&D roadmap. Your profile Education: Master’s or Ph.D. in Photonics, Optoelectronics, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related field (a Ph.D. with an experimental packaging or integration focus is strongly preferred). Hands-on Experience: 5+ years of hands-on R&D experience in photonic/optoelectronic packaging, hybrid integration, or high-density interconnect development within a research institution, deep-tech startup, or advanced R&D environment. Prototyping & Co-Integration Track Record: Proven experience conceiving, building, and characterizing novel packaging prototypes-specifically co-integrating PICs, laser sources/SOAs, photodetectors, and high-speed analog electronics. Technical Depth: Deep understanding of optical alignment/coupling methods, flip-chip/wire bonding, die attach, hermetic encapsulation, RF signal integrity, and thermal management. Lab & Tool Proficiency: Hands-on proficiency with optical characterization (insertion loss, far-field imaging, OLCR/OFDR, LIV testing) and electrical characterization tools (VNA, high-speed oscilloscopes). Familiarity with CAD layout tools and optical simulation software (e.g., Zemax , Lumerical ) is a plus. Mindset & Ownership: High degree of autonomy and creative problem-solving skills to navigate complex, competing constraints without off-the-shelf solutions. Strong self-leadership and collaboration skills. Languages: Fluent in English; knowledge of German or another European language is a plus. Why us? Work on the leading edge: Photonic AI acceleration technologies that will define the next decade of computing - already validated in production HPC environments. Make impact at scale: Help solve one of computing's biggest challenges - making growing demand in compute and sustainability go hand in hand. Own your work from day one: Broad autonomy and decision authority with direct impact on product success, packaging baselines, and overall PIC module quality. Fast-track your growth: Work on challenges with few industry precedents - every problem you solve becomes new institutional knowledge and potentially industry-defining IP. World-class team: Collaborate alongside a passionate, international, cross-functional team of experts in photonics, processor design, and AI systems. Direct access to leadership: Work closely with the company's leaders within a transparent and fast-moving structure. Collaborative culture: Innovative work environment that values technical excellence, open communication, and pragmatic problem-solving. Be part of history: Join at the inflection point where photonic computing transitions from research to mainstream—your contributions will shape this transformation. As a Graduate Quantitative Researcher, you’ll work across the full research process, from framing the question and choosing the data to building, testing and deploying models. Machine Learning is central to the work, whether you’re extracting signals, forecasting prices or modelling relationships. Our data, compute and production infrastructure let you test ideas quickly, understand where they fail and decide what to investigate next.</p> <p>Our researchers believe in academic discourse and invite fellow researchers, traders and engineers to challenge each hypothesis. Different perspectives help improve the question, the model and how it performs in production. Through constant testing, analysis and refinement, you’ll help our quantitative models adapt as markets evolve.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO</strong></p> <p><strong>Your onboarding&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>You’ll&nbsp;participate&nbsp;in&nbsp;<a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ONPObMHh-k8">Global Optiver Academy</a>, a structured&nbsp;onboarding programme for graduates. That could include:</p> <ul> <li>Building models for pricing, forecasting and signal discovery, choosing the statistical, mathematical or Machine Learning methods that best fit the problem.</li> <li>Working across petabytes of market, order-flow and unstructured data to find signals that improve strategies as conditions change.</li> <li>Monitoring models in production and using live behavior to refine your assumptions and decide what to investigate next.</li> <li>Using deep learning and AI-enabled workflows to shorten the loop from hypothesis to evidence.</li> <li>Working directly with researchers, traders and engineers to shape problems and understand how system constraints affect performance.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHO YOU ARE</strong></p> <p>We're looking for aspiring Quantitative Researchers who are versatile and creative in innovating and suggesting new solutions. title: Data Director, Payments
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as&nbsp;<a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and&nbsp;<a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us.&nbsp;</p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><p>📍London or UK Remote | 💰 £150,000 - £200, 000 + Equity +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a>&nbsp;</p> <p><br><strong>About our Data Discipline&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. Data is central to how we understand our customers, shape our products, manage risk and grow Monzo sustainably. We believe in empowering teams with high-quality, trusted data and self-serve analytics, while creating space for Data practitioners to focus on the highest-impact questions, opportunities and decisions.</p> <p>Our Data discipline is centralised, but deeply embedded in Monzo’s product areas. Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers and Analysts work in cross-functional squads alongside Engineers, Designers, Product Managers, Marketers and other specialists. This means Data is not a downstream service: we help shape strategy, challenge thinking, build the data foundations teams need to move quickly, and share accountability for customer and commercial outcomes.</p> <h2><strong>Our Payments team ⭐</strong></h2> <p>At Monzo, payments are more than just moving money from A to B. They are a core part of how customers experience trust, speed, and financial control every day. As a Data Director in Payments, you would help shape seamless local payment experiences, ensuring customers can pay and get paid reliably while continuing to modernise the infrastructure that powers millions of transactions behind the scenes.</p> <p>The role also sits at the intersection of Monzo’s broader ambition to build truly borderless banking and expand into new markets. That means designing products and payment capabilities that work effortlessly across geographies, currencies, and customer needs, while helping Monzo scale into new markets with the same simplicity and transparency that defines the brand today.</p> <p>You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Design to help shape Monzo’s payments strategy to make Monzo's global ambitions a reality, enabling revenue and customer growth with a resilient, self-serve banking platform.&nbsp;</p> <p>To succeed, you should be excited about solving tough, ambiguous business problems with analytical rigour, commercial viability and execution effectiveness<br><br></p> <p><strong>Your day-to-day&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Establish yourself as a trusted member of the Payments Leadership team, enabling better decisions across Payments and the wider Data Discipline</li> <li>Co-drive Payments strategy and product decisions with Product and Engineering, bringing Data into discovery early to shape priorities and challenge thinking</li> <li>Identify untapped opportunities for commercial optimisation, including across pricing, commercialisation, investment and customer growth</li> <li>Set the data strategy for Payments, including the operating model, team priorities, architecture, technical debt and key metrics and drivers</li> <li>Translate between technical, product and commercial perspectives to help teams make clear, high-impact decisions</li> <li>Develop and scale a high-performing team of data professionals sharing accountability for product and business outcomes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <p>What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</p> <ul> <li>You have experience driving payments innovation and product strategy forward in a fast-growing business</li> <li>You combine deep Data expertise with strong product and commercial judgement.&nbsp;</li> <li>You can move comfortably from detailed metrics or architecture discussions to customer strategy, pricing and business outcomes</li> <li>You are an empathetic people leader who can build trust quickly, raise the performance bar and retain excellent talent</li> <li>You have experience growing and leading a full stack data team, including individual contributors and managers across Data Science, Analytics Engineering, Machine Learning Engineering and Analytics</li> <li>You have experience collaborating with senior cross-functional stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing and risk/control functions</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Interview Process</strong></p> <p>After an informal ~30 min recruiter call, our interview process involves 2 main stages. We promise not to ask you any brain teasers or trick questions!</p> <ol> <li><strong>Initial Call (1 hour)</strong> You'll meet with one of our senior data leaders.</li> <li><strong>Loop Stage</strong> - This is one stage with 4 interviews (totalling 4 hours) split between a collaboration with one of our engineers on a technical exercise, as well as behavioural and leadership interviews. You can have this all in one day or split these across multiple days, whichever your prefer.</li> </ol> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact us on ----- <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>How we work 💻:</strong></p> <p><strong>Locations &amp; Flexible Working :&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles.&nbsp;</p> <p>We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches &amp; treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.&nbsp;</p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨</p> <p>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</p> <h3><strong>What’s in it for you</strong></h3> <p>💰Base salary £150, 000 - £200, 000 + Equity + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>&nbsp;</p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>#LI-AL1 #LI-REMOTE</p> <p><a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"><strong><br><br></strong></a></p> <p><br><br></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Customer Success Advisor - German speaking
description: The company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. The role Customer Service Advisors are the first point of contact for potential customers as well as new and existing customers, and thus the “face” of iwoca. You handle incoming calls, emails and web chats, supporting entrepreneurs with general inquiries, new applications and repeat loans. You highly value our customer service and support customers with your excellent communication skills so they can successfully utilise our products. A fundamental component for our success is to convince and inspire customers and partners of our mission - this ranges from hair salons and dental practices to financial advisory services and banks. The requirements Essential: Demonstrates curiosity to use and learn more about AI tools. You’ll already be comfortable using AI tools in practical ways to help solve problems, increase productivity and improve quality of work, showing good judgement about when to use them and the ability to explain the reasoning behind that use. We look for people who are smart, humble, motivated and always looking to improve. You enjoy communicating with customers and live "customer centricity". Your greatest motivation is achieving success with our customers. You have completed a commercial training / business studies (kaufmännische Ausbildung / betriebswirtschaftliches Studium) and can add value with relevant professional experience in customer service (experiences in the banking environment or a fintech are a plus). You are highly motivated, organised, a true team player and have a 'hands-on' mentality. You possess C1-level German communication skills (both written and spoken) and are comfortable collaborating in English within our diverse, international office. An independent, team-oriented and reliable way of working is a given. Don’t take this list as prescriptive: it’s just to give you a sense of who might do well at the job. We’d still love to hear from you if you don’t hit every point on the list, or if you have other experience. Your mission: You are responsible for the overall customer satisfaction and ensure that customer inquiries via phone, email or web chat are handled promptly and efficiently. You answer questions about our products, the application process and our service in general, supporting both new and existing customers. You assist entrepreneurs in completing their applications and providing the necessary documents required for a credit decision. You collaborate with various teams within iwoca to achieve the best outcome for our customers. You proactively participate in the development of iwoca by providing regular insights on customer feedback, opportunities to improve our processes or new offerings from our competitors. Work-life balance is incredibly important at iwoca and we offer flexible working so you can make better use of your free time. This is a hybrid role in which you can split your time between the office and home. We want to make iwoca a place where everyone feels welcome, where you can confidently be yourself. We understand that inclusivity, and diversity that comes through greater inclusivity, isn't an optional add-on; it's the core ingredient of what makes us great. We care about making iwoca a healthy and happy community for all of our team members to thrive in. The salary We expect to pay from £28,000 — £36,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews. The culture At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time. The offices We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work: Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks. Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions. The benefits Flexible working hours. Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership. A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses. A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents. 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave. A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years. Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support. 3% Pension contributions on total earnings. An employee equity incentive scheme. Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money. Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme. Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield. And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer: A learning and development budget for everyone. Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers. Access to learning platforms like Treehouse. What You’ll Do

Technical Ownership & QA

  • Build and ship pages/components directly in Storyblok CMS: component configuration, staging, QA, and production deployment across market versions

  • QA every release technically — rendering, functionality, and cross-browser/device behaviour, not just copy and visual polish

  • Use AI tools as a core part of daily production work (drafting, layout variants, QA support), and know where AI output still needs a human check, particularly around localisation nuance and experiment validity

Request Triage & Scoping

  • Own intake for web requests: qualify, triage, and estimate technical complexity and dependencies before anything is scoped or scheduled

  • Enforce briefing standards and know enough technically to explain why a brief is incomplete

  • Decide what can be handled directly vs. what needs to go to the development team, and write specs the team can act on without excessive clarification

Project Coordination

  • Act as day-to-day PM between the development team and business stakeholders: track scope, delivery, and risk

  • Maintain the web backlog and sprint board with clear status, ownership, and blockers

  • Support CRO initiatives: help build A/B test setups, document hypotheses, and track experiment results

  • Maintain intake templates, briefing standards, and triage criteria

  • Produce regular status updates and pipeline reports for the Head of Web and wider leadership

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with Storyblok or a comparable headless CMS

  • Familiarity with web analytics or conversion tracking concepts

  • Exposure to A/B testing/CRO tools, or basic SQL

  • Experience briefing or QA’ing a development team

  • Basic understanding of Core Web Vitals / page performance

  • Familiarity with SEO fundamentals as they intersect with web production


What We Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12–16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 “Work from Anywhere” days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Coursera + Udemy</strong></p> <p>Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world’s most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12,000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI.</p> <p><strong>Why join us now?</strong></p> <p>AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them.</p> <p><strong>Shape what comes next</strong></p> <p>By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.</p></div><p><strong>Where we Work</strong></p> <p>Udemy is a global company headquartered in San Francisco, with additional U.S. offices in Denver and Austin, and international hubs in Australia, India, Ireland, Mexico, and Türkiye.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About this role</strong></p> <p>This is a senior in-house legal role for a commercially driven lawyer ready to take commercial legal programs work with partners and negotiate technology deals. The role reports directly to the Head of Commercial Legal, Strategic Growth.<br>&nbsp;<br>We operate a hybrid go-to-market model that combines demand-led direct sales, solution-led growth, and indirect distribution through a tiered partner and channel ecosystem. We reach organizations globally through technology alliances, GSI relationships, channel partners, and reseller arrangements — powering learning and capability-building at scale. Legal sits at the center of all three motions.<br>&nbsp;<br>You will be a dedicated legal partner for B2B Enterprise, Technology Alliances, and Channel and Distribution Partnerships, supporting the development and negotiation of the indirect partner ecosystem that underpins our scalable distribution. This is a role for someone who combines deep transactional expertise with strong business instincts, operates with a high degree of independence, and is ready to grow into broader leadership responsibility within a scaling legal function.</p> <p><strong>About your skills</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Exceptional business judgement and a proven ability to balance legal risk with commercial objectives in fast-moving deal environments.</p> </li> <li> <p>Executive-level communication skills: able to distill complex issues into clear, actionable guidance and influence stakeholders from SMB to large enterprise and C-suite.</p> </li> <li> <p>A track record of using approved AI tools to increase legal productivity, and staying current on AI governance obligations.</p> </li> </ul> negotiating complex commercial agreements across global system integrator arrangements, channel partner and reseller agreements, technology alliance and co-sell agreements, enterprise SaaS and platform licensing, API and technical integration agreements, and distribution and go-to-market partnerships.</p> </li> <li> <p>Advise senior business stakeholders, including GTM leadership, and Product teams, on deal structuring, risk allocation, commercial terms, and multi-jurisdictional GTM considerations, serving as the day-to-day legal lead who positions Legal as a genuine business enabler.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with the Product Legal team to develop and refine legal frameworks that support a self-serve and low-touch commercial motion, including API access agreements, developer terms, usage-based licensing structures, and SMB onboarding frameworks, contributing to a standardized, scalable approach that enables businesses to engage and onboard with speed and minimal friction.</p> </li> <li> <p>Provide clear, solution-focused guidance on AI-related commercial arrangements, data-sharing agreements, and emerging technology implementations as they enter the enterprise deal mix.</p> </li> <li> <p>Own and continuously develop the suite of enterprise and channel contracting templates, playbooks, negotiation guidelines, and approval frameworks used across the partnerships function.</p> </li> <li> <p>Design scalable legal infrastructure that empowers fast-moving deal teams to execute efficiently while maintaining sound risk controls across both direct and indirect channels.</p> </li> <li>&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>GTM Product Commercialisation and Third-Party Integration</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Act as a primary legal partner for the commercialisation of GTM products, advising on go-to-market structures, route-to-market models, pricing and packaging frameworks, and the legal terms that govern how products are brought to market directly and through third parties.</p> </li> <li> <p>Draft and negotiate agreements that govern the embedding, bundling, or distribution of our products within third-party platforms, marketplaces, and ecosystems, including white-label arrangements, OEM agreements, co-branded offerings, and platform integration terms.</p> </li> <li> <p>Advise on licensing boundaries and revenue-sharing constructs as the product suite evolves and is commercialised through an expanding range of direct and indirect channels.</p> </li> <li> <p>Work closely with Product, Product Legal, Marketing, and Sales to ensure commercial and legal structures keep pace with product development and new route-to-market initiatives, flagging and resolving legal considerations early in the product lifecycle.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll have&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Genuinely commercial in your approach: able to identify and manage risk pragmatically, find workable solutions under pressure, and avoid being a blocker to growth.</p> </li> <li> <p>An effective communicator and influencer, comfortable advising and challenging senior stakeholders across Sales, Product, and Executive leadership.</p> </li> <li> <p>Qualified lawyer with 10+ years of post-qualification experience, including meaningful in-house tenure at a technology, SaaS, or enterprise software company.</p> </li> <li> <p>A proven track record negotiating complex B2B technology agreements including GSI, channel, reseller, alliance, and enterprise platform deals, ideally within or alongside global organisations.</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrable experience advising on product commercialisation, route-to-market strategy, or third-party distribution and embedding arrangements.</p> </li> <li> <p>Comfortable operating across both high-touch enterprise deals and high-volume standardised indirect channel frameworks, understanding that each requires a different legal posture.</p> </li> <li> <p>Highly organised and self-directed, with a demonstrated ability to manage a high-volume deal workload across competing priorities and deadlines with minimal supervision.</p> </li> <li> <p>A collaborative team player who understands their place in a broader legal function and actively supports those around them, including upward to leadership</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Posting Date: </strong>15 September 2026<br><strong>Application Window: 2 weeks</strong><br>We anticipate the application window will be open until 30 September 2026. Based on business needs, this opportunity may remain posted beyond or closed before the anticipated application window.</p> <p class="p1"><strong><em>#LI-ST5</em></strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>Why work here?</strong></h3> <p><strong>You’ll grow here.</strong><strong><br></strong>Learning is part of the job. You’ll get full access to Udemy courses, a monthly UDay to invest in yourself, and a budget to spend on whatever helps you improve. Many people are diving into AI lately, but what you focus on is up to you.</p> <p><strong>AI is real here.</strong><strong><br></strong>We use it in the way we learn and the way we work. You’ll have the space and tools to experiment, apply, and get better at using AI in practical ways.</p> <p><strong>You’ll own your work.</strong><strong><br></strong>We trust people to lead, make decisions, and follow through. Everyone has a voice, and good thinking is welcomed from any direction.</p> <p><strong>You’ll see your impact.</strong><strong><br></strong>What you build helps people grow their skills, change their careers, or find a path forward. You’ve got the experience, why not use it to help others gain theirs?</p> <p><em>Bring your curiosity. We’ll bring the platform and the support. Let’s <strong>LEARN</strong>&nbsp;together.&nbsp;</em></p> <h3><strong>Our Benefits Start with U</strong></h3> <p>Our benefits start with you and were built to provide you and your family with the protection and care you need, making it easy to access the right coverage when you need it most. description: We’re on a mission to make migration easy. We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans. But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones. To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest. We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you. London (hybrid, 3 days in office) Car Finance at Marshmallow Marshmallow is opening up access to credit to migrants, bringing a brand new product to market which provides newcomers to the UK with fairly priced car finance for the first time. Our Car Finance team is building a new generation lending platform from the ground up, making it simple, transparent and accessible for people who need finance to get on the road. We work closely with dealers, brokers and customers to make sure that every application, decision and interaction is fast, fair and easy to understand. Because we’re a small, high-performing team, everyone has real ownership. We combine hands-on operations with a strong focus on automation and technology. We’re designing highly automated, AI-powered processes that let us move faster and smarter than traditional lenders. The Role We're hiring a Data Scientist to sit at the heart of how we lend: who we say yes to, at what price, and how we know it's working. Our customers are people that traditional lenders struggle to assess. Many are new to the UK, have thin or no credit files, and don't fit neatly into off-the-shelf bureau scores. That makes credit decisioning at Marshmallow a genuinely hard, genuinely interesting problem: we combine bureau data, Open Banking, insurance, application and behavioural data to build a view of risk that others can't, and we need to do it in a way that is fair, explainable and compliant. This role sits between a traditional credit analyst and a data scientist. You'll build and monitor scorecards, design and test credit strategies, dig into portfolio performance to find out what's really going on, and turn large, messy datasets into insights that change how we lend. You'll own your work end-to-end: from framing the question and pulling the data through to modelling, presenting a recommendation and seeing it live in our decision engine. You'll be working with a small team and a modern stack, alongside a Head of Credit who has built this function from scratch and who will give you real ownership from day one. This is not a role where you hand models over a wall and move on - you'll see the impact of your decisions immediately. What you'll be doing Build, validate and monitor application and behavioural scorecards, using bureau, Open Banking and internal data to improve how we assess new-to-UK and thin-file customers. Design, test and refine our credit strategy: cut-offs, affordability rules, pricing tiers and limits, with a clear view of the trade-off between risk, volume and margin. Run experiments and champion/challenge tests to prove that changes to policy and models actually work before we scale them. Explore new data sources and alternative signals, and build the case for using (or not using) them in decisioning. Support model governance: document what you build, evidence that it treats customers fairly, and help us meet our Consumer Duty, CONC and model risk obligations. Work with our engineers to get models and rules into production, and use AI tooling to make yourself and the team faster. What You'll Bring Must have 2–5 years' experience in decision science or data science within consumer lending or another regulated financial services environment. Hands-on experience developing or materially refining credit scorecards or risk models (logistic regression and/or gradient boosting), including the practicalities: sample design, binning, reject inference, validation and monitoring. Experience working with Open Banking or other alternative data in credit decisioning. SQL user, and comfortable working with large, imperfect datasets. A solid grounding in statistics and a good instinct for when a result is real and when it isn't. Commercial judgement: you can translate a model output into a lending decision and explain the trade-offs to a non-technical audience. Curiosity and ownership. You ask why, you dig until you find the answer, and you'd rather ship something and improve it than wait for perfection. Nice to have Motor finance or other secured lending experience. Experience of working within a rapidly scaling lending environment. Familiarity with UK consumer credit regulation and how it shapes model design and use. Experience using LLMs to speed up analytical work. You already know some of the tooling Marshmallow uses: Snowflake, Python, Claude, Linear, Notion Perks of the job Bonus scheme designed to reward high performance Private medical insurance with Vitality, mental health support with Oliva Personal learning budget and 2 dedicated L&D days a year Monthly flexible benefits budget to spend as you choose 25 days holiday plus bank holidays 4 weeks Work From Anywhere per year We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this position. Because we’re a small, high-performing team, everyone has real ownership. We combine hands-on operations with a strong focus on automation and technology. We’re designing highly automated, AI-powered processes that let us move faster and smarter than traditional lenders.

The Role

We're hiring a Data Scientist to sit at the heart of how we lend: who we say yes to, at what price, and how we know it's working.

Our customers are people that traditional lenders struggle to assess. Many are new to the UK, have thin or no credit files, and don't fit neatly into off-the-shelf bureau scores. That makes credit decisioning at Marshmallow a genuinely hard, genuinely interesting problem: we combine bureau data, Open Banking, insurance, application and behavioural data to build a view of risk that others can't, and we need to do it in a way that is fair, explainable and compliant.

This role sits between a traditional credit analyst and a data scientist. You'll build and monitor scorecards, design and test credit strategies, dig into portfolio performance to find out what's really going on, and turn large, messy datasets into insights that change how we lend. You'll own your work end-to-end: from framing the question and pulling the data through to modelling, presenting a recommendation and seeing it live in our decision engine.

You'll be working with a small team and a modern stack, alongside a Head of Credit who has built this function from scratch and who will give you real ownership from day one. This is not a role where you hand models over a wall and move on - you'll see the impact of your decisions immediately.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Run experiments and champion/challenge tests to prove that changes to policy and models actually work before we scale them.

  • Explore new data sources and alternative signals, and build the case for using (or not using) them in decisioning.

  • Support model governance: document what you build, evidence that it treats customers fairly, and help us meet our Consumer Duty, CONC and model risk obligations.

  • Work with our engineers to get models and rules into production, and use AI tooling to make yourself and the team faster.

What You'll Bring

Must have

  • 2–5 years' experience in decision science or data science within consumer lending or another regulated financial services environment.

  • Hands-on experience developing or materially refining credit scorecards or risk models (logistic regression and/or gradient boosting), including the practicalities: sample design, binning, reject inference, validation and monitoring.

  • Experience working with Open Banking or other alternative data in credit decisioning.

  • SQL user, and comfortable working with large, imperfect datasets.

  • A solid grounding in statistics and a good instinct for when a result is real and when it isn't.

  • Commercial judgement: you can translate a model output into a lending decision and explain the trade-offs to a non-technical audience.

  • Curiosity and ownership. You ask why, you dig until you find the answer, and you'd rather ship something and improve it than wait for perfection.

Nice to have

Infinitesima?</strong></p> <p>Based in Abingdon, Oxfordshire, Infinitesima develops advanced semiconductor metrology technology that is helping enable the next generation of electronics manufacturing.</p> <p>Our technology combines cutting-edge software, precision mechanics, motion control and nanoscale measurement science to solve some of the most challenging problems in arm of Applied Materials, one of the global leaders in semiconductor equipment.</p> <p>This is an opportunity to register your interest with a company where software engineering directly influences Software Engineers who bring one or more of the following:</p> <ul> <li>Industrial C#/.NET development experience</li> <li>Desktop application development using WPF or similar frameworks</li> systems</li> <li>Experience working alongside electronics, optics, hardware or mechanical engineering teams</li> </ul> <p>Additional experience that would be advantageous includes:</p> <ul> <li>Python development</li> <li>C++ development</li> <li>Messaging and communication technologies such as DDS, MQTT, RabbitMQ, ZeroMQ or Named Pipes</li> <li>Agile software delivery and sprint-based development environments</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Future Software Engineering Opportunities Could Involve</strong></p> <p>Depending on the role and level, future opportunities could include:</p> <ul> <li>Designing and developing C#/.NET applications for semiconductor inspection and metrology systems</li> <li>Developing software that controls precision motion systems and nanoscale positioning technologies</li> <li>Building user interfaces and HMI applications using WPF and related technologies</li> <li>Integrating software with motion controllers, piezo actuators, sensors and data roles)</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We're Interested In</strong></p> <p>We're particularly interested in hearing from engineers who have experience in one or more of the following environments:</p> <ul> <li>Industrial automation</li> <li>Motion control systems</li> <li>Robotics</li> <li>Scientific instrumentation</li> <li>Semiconductor equipment</li> <li>Metrology systems</li> <li>Manufacturing automation</li> <li>Control systems engineering</li> <li>High-precision electromechanical systems</li> <li>Research and development environments</li> </ul> <p>For early-career engineers, a strong academic background in computer science, software engineering, mathematics, physics or another scientific discipline is highly valuable.</p> <p>For more experienced engineers, experience within scientific, engineering or hardware-focused industries would be particularly relevant.</p> <p><strong>This Talent Pool May Be a Good Fit If...</strong></p> <ul> <li>You've developed software that challenges involving software, electronics and mechanical systems</li> <li>You're excited by the idea of contributing to advanced semiconductor technology</li> </ul> <p><strong>This Talent Pool Is platforms</em></li> <li><em>You have limited exposure to hardware-integrated software or engineering products</em></li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <p>We're interested in candidates who have:</p> <ul> <li>A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics or a related discipline</li> </ul> <p>OR</p> <ul> <li>Equivalent commercial experience developing complex engineering software systems</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Join Our Talent Community</strong></p> <p>If you're interested in future Software Engineering opportunities at Infinitesima, we'd encourage you to apply and introduce yourself.</p> <p>Future positions are expected to span multiple levels, from Software Engineer through to Principal Engineer, with compensation and responsibilities aligned to experience, capability and scope of role.</p> <p>By joining our Software Engineer Talent Pool, you'll be among the first professionals we consider when suitable opportunities become available.
